name: Chad
famous_for: Ennedi Plateau desert sandstone arches and gueltas, Lake Chad waters, and Zakouma National Park elephant herds.
tourists: Approx. 90,000 desert adventurers; famous for Guelta d'Archei desert camel pool and Tibesti volcanic peaks.
must_know: Guelta d'Archei in the Ennedi Plateau is a dramatic desert canyon where hundreds of camels drink alongside rare dwarf Saharan crocodiles.
fun_fact: Chad is named after Lake Chad, which was once a colossal prehistoric inland sea dubbed 'Mega-Chad' covering 350,000 square km.
